## Student supervision {#student-supervision}

I supervise undergraduate dissertations at the University of Plymouth. Previously, I assisted with MSc dissertation supervision at Cardiff University and the University of Reading.

For prospective PhD enquiries, see my [research interests](../research/index.qmd) and [funding and contact information](../index.qmd#collaboration).

**Urban climate and its influence on buildings** — Guest lecture, Department of Engineering, University of Exeter, UK, February 2026.
